name: Navigation bar
statusNote: The flexible/"short" variant, horizontal items, and new colors are new in Expressive; the classic vertical-only bar is unchanged from M3.
summary: A bottom bar of 3-5 (up to 6 in the flexible variant) top-level destinations, always visible on compact/medium widths. Use it instead of a rail once the window is too narrow to dock navigation to a side.

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: 3-5 destination items (up to 6 in the flexible variant), each with selected, onClick, icon and optional label.

inputs.name: flexible
inputs.description: Selects the flexible ("short") bar instead of the standard fixed-height bar.

inputs.name: itemIconPosition
inputs.description: Per-item icon position: stacked above the label (top/vertical item) or beside it (start/horizontal item). The recommended binding is by window width: compact uses top, medium and wider (>=600dp) uses start, but a caller can pin either explicitly.

inputs.name: arrangement
inputs.description: Flexible bar only: equal-weight matches the standard bar's equal-share division; centered groups items with padding computed from item count, capped at 6 items.

inputs.name: alwaysShowLabel
inputs.description: Whether to always show an item's label, or only when it is selected.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: Full-width bar anchored to the bottom edge.

anatomy.name: Item
anatomy.description: Icon + label, one per destination, equal share of the bar's width.

anatomy.name: Active indicator
anatomy.description: Pill behind the icon (and label, in the horizontal layout) of the selected item.

anatomy.name: Badge
anatomy.description: Optional small dot or numeral anchored to the icon.

variants.description: Default; icon stacked above label; compact widths.
Compact-width flexible bar, equal-weight arrangement, 3-5 items.
Medium+ width flexible bar, centered arrangement, icon beside label, 3-6 items.

layout.text: Item icon position is an explicit top (vertical) or start (horizontal) choice, not an automatic breakpoint switch in the renderer itself — but the recommended binding is by window width: compact windows use vertical items with equal-weight distribution, medium and wider windows (>=600dp) use horizontal items with centered distribution.
Standard (non-flexible) bar: items always occupy equal fixed-width shares of the bar (width divided by item count), vertical layout only.
Flexible bar, equal-weight arrangement: same equal-share division as the standard bar.

Flexible bar, centered arrangement: items are centered as a group with horizontal padding computed from item count, capped at 6 items (padding is 0 beyond 6): paddingPercentage = ((100 - 10*(itemCount+3)) / 2) / 100 of the bar width per side — i.e. items occupy 60% of width at 3 items, 70% at 4, 80% at 5, 90% at 6. Each item may still grow past its minimum share up to barWidth/itemCount, and growth reduces the padding on that item's side to keep the group centered.

The horizontal-item indicator's horizontal inset from the item edge comes from the horizontal-item's leading/trailing space tokens; the vertical-item indicator is centered and sized to its own width x height tokens, independent of icon size — indicator padding is (indicatorSize - iconSize) / 2 on each axis.
Bar height is container-height for both variants (64dp); the old 80dp "tall" height token is legacy/M3-classic only and is not read by the flexible bar.
If the bar is given unbounded width, items keep their natural intrinsic width instead of splitting the available space evenly.

states.text: Single-select (role tab, selectable group); pressing an inactive item selects it and deselects the previous one.

states.label: indicator-motion
states.text: Indicator width/position and the icon/label cross-fade both animate on a fast spatial spring for the pill's grow/shrink and slide.

states.label: colour-motion
states.text: Icon and label colour/opacity transitions animate on a default-effects spring.

states.label: icon-position-reflow
states.text: When an item's icon position animates between top and start (e.g. the flexible bar reflowing on a width change), the position interpolation itself uses a default-spatial spring, and the label swaps between the vertical-item and horizontal-item label type styles at the animation's halfway point.
Unselected items keep icon-only or icon+label per the bar's label-visibility setting; MDC default shows labels only for the selected item unless "always show" is set.

behaviour.text: The centered/equal-weight arrangement is a bar-level choice, not per-item; don't mix indicator geometry from the two item groups within one bar.

Item width growth (an item wider than its minimum share) recenters the whole group by adjusting the bar's outer padding, not by re-splitting neighboring items — replicate the padding-shift math rather than a naive flex-box distribution.

keyboard: Arrow keys move focus within the tab group.
Enter or Space selects the focused item.
semantics: Each item has role tab and a minimum touch target regardless of the visual item/indicator size.
Screen readers announce the item's label and selected state; unlabeled icon-only items must still carry a content description.

notes.text: Bar-level "flexible" and item-level icon position are independent knobs: a renderer should let a caller force top/start at any width, but the default should follow the >=600dp rule.
Don't conflate the classic 80dp tall-container-height with the Expressive 64dp default; the flexible bar always reuses the 64dp token.
